editorial.tldr: Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 reached Google Antigravity on Oct 20, giving developers a per-task model choice inside an agentic IDE. Three days later R&D World set Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro against Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra, making Opus 5.5 the reference point for open-weight challengers.
editorial.whats_new: Anthropic's Nov 9 guide compares Fable, Opus, Sonnet and Haiku on cost and use, and shows how to combine them, so model routing is now documented first-party guidance.
editorial.why_it_matters: Opus 5.5 is both the model teams route to and the yardstick Kimi K3.1 Pro is measured against, so tiering and challenger evals now rest on the same baseline.
editorial.take_for_builders: Read Anthropic's Nov 9 tiering guide against your current routing, and rerun your own evals on Opus 5.5 versus Kimi K3.1 Pro before moving any traffic, since the comparison item reports no verified results.

status.detail: The thread now spans Opus 5.5 distribution, a Kimi K3.1 Pro comparison against it, and Anthropic's own model-selection guidance; the items here do not report independent eval results.
